self_conditional_modifiers_json.description: Wavebreaking Thunder: ATK +16/20/24/28/32% (R1-R5), unconditional -- auto-applied at the chosen refinement.

R1 Wavebreaking Thunder, wielder half of the ENHANCED Attendant's Measure: while it is up, the wielder's own Stellar-Conduct hits grant the wielder a further +16% ATK. Pair with the team entry attendantsMeasure on its 'enhanced' state. R2-R5 in refinementStates.

team_conditional_modifiers_json.description: R1 Wavebreaking Thunder: when the wielder's Electro attacks hit, they gain Attendant's Measure for 15s: the ACTIVE character's Stellar-Conduct reaction DMG +20%; while it lasts, the wielder's own Stellar-Conduct hits enhance it, a further +20% (+40%). Works off-field. Team scope, assuming the scored character is the active one. R2-R5 in refinementStates.

source.note: 7.3 weapon (Danica's signature), added 2026-11-21 from nanoka 7.2.52 pre-release data; GO and Amber carry nothing yet. Base stats = init x levels['90'] + last ascension add (741 ATK / 16.5% ATK, matching nanoka's weapon index). The unconditional ATK has no param of its own: it is param[2] like the enhanced ATK (16/32% at R1/R5 in both the text and the params).
